context_specification.scope: Context synchronization and brief generation for SKIIN Switzerland project

context_validation_specifications.name: Context File Integrity Check
validation_procedures: Validate file format and structure per CLAUDE_PROCESS.md v5.0
Verify required sections and headers exist
Check version numbers and timestamps for currency
Validate event-stream.md uses one-line format per system requirements
Ensure todo.md follows hierarchical task structure with proper status tracking
Verify planning.md maintains phase-based organization structure
consistency_checks: Cross-reference todo.md tasks with planning.md phases and milestones
Verify event-stream.md entries match actual file changes and git history
Validate doc-ref.md paths exist and are current (v5.1 compliance)
Check conventions.md references match actual codebase patterns
Ensure requirements.md aligns with active todo.md tasks
Verify project-index.md reflects current repository structure
error_handling: Log missing files as critical errors in event-stream.md
Flag inconsistencies for manual review with specific line references
Create restoration tasks for corrupted files in todo.md
Escalate structural problems to administrator via error events
Automatically backup corrupt files before restoration attempts

context_validation_specifications.name: Subagent Context Isolation Check
validation_procedures: Verify context/subagent-contexts/ directory exists and is organized
Check that context files are properly isolated per agent type
Validate JSON structure of context brief files
Ensure proper cleanup of temporary context files after task completion
consistency_checks: Verify subagent context briefs contain required fields (brief_id, timestamp, objective)
Check that context briefs reference current PROJECT_INDEX.json structure
Validate that parallel execution contexts don't overlap or conflict
Ensure context isolation prevents information leakage between agents
error_handling: Clean up orphaned context files older than 24 hours
Log context isolation violations as security events
Restore missing context templates from context/subagent-contexts/TEMPLATE.md

brief_format.structure: JSON with standardized sections per WORKFLOWS.md
content_requirements: Single, clear objective statement with measurable success criteria
Aggregated specifications from all relevant subagents with conflict resolution
Step-by-step implementation procedures with validation checkpoints
Rollback and recovery procedures for failure scenarios
Context brief must include relevant PROJECT_INDEX.json sections
Self-priming instructions for target agent execution

generation_procedures.action: Collect outputs from all relevant subagents
generation_procedures.processing: Extract actionable implementation details and resolve conflicts

requirements: Resolve conflicts between specifications using priority matrix
Prioritize implementation steps based on dependency graph
Ensure completeness against requirements.md acceptance criteria
Validate brief against SKIIN Switzerland project conventions

criteria: All necessary information included for independent execution
Implementation steps are actionable with clear validation criteria
Success metrics are measurable and time-bound
Context information is current and relevant to PROJECT_INDEX.json
Brief follows Swiss healthcare compliance requirements

storage_specifications.retention: Delete after successful implementation and validation
storage_specifications.backup: Store brief summary in memory graph as task entity
storage_specifications.versioning: Maintain brief history for complex multi-phase implementations

synchronization_specifications.name: Task Status Synchronization
sync_procedures: When task marked complete in todo.md, update corresponding phase progress in planning.md
Add completion event to event-stream.md with proper format: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] Completion - [TASK-ID] Description | Phase: Complete
Update knowledge graph task entity status using mcp__memory__add_observations
Archive completed task context files from subagent-contexts/

conflict_resolution.conflict_type: Task exists in planning but not todo
conflict_resolution.resolution: Add missing task to todo.md with proper ID and status
conflict_resolution.escalation: If task is complex, decompose using planning-task-agent

conflict_resolution.conflict_type: Task complete in todo but phase not updated
conflict_resolution.resolution: Update planning.md phase progress and milestone status
conflict_resolution.validation: Verify all phase tasks are actually complete before phase closure

conflict_resolution.conflict_type: Event-stream entry missing for completed task
conflict_resolution.resolution: Generate completion event with timestamp and proper format
conflict_resolution.validation: Ensure event follows mandatory description protocol

synchronization_specifications.name: Documentation Reference Synchronization
sync_procedures: When new documentation is created, immediately update doc-ref.md v5.1 structure
Verify all referenced paths in planning.md exist in doc-ref.md
Archive obsolete docs per 7-day lifecycle rule to archive/YYYY-MM-DD/

conflict_resolution.resolution: Add missing document with proper categorization and status
conflict_resolution.escalation: Check if document should be archived or relocated

conflict_resolution.resolution: Remove dead reference or restore file from archive
conflict_resolution.validation: Verify file restoration doesn't create duplicates

monitoring_requirements: Run 'tree -L 3' command to capture current structure snapshot
Store structure snapshot in project-index.md with timestamp
Compare with previous snapshot to identify significant changes
Update PROJECT_INDEX.json when structural changes exceed threshold (10+ files)
Monitor for file organization violations per docs/file-organization-framework.md
change_detection: New directories created in src/, docs/, or context/
Key files added or removed (components, services, migrations)
Component structure modifications affecting atomic design principles
Documentation organization changes in docs/ hierarchy
Root directory pollution (files not in allowed 15-file limit)
documentation_updates: Update 'Current Project Structure' section in planning.md
Add structure change events to event-stream.md with STRUCTURAL category
Update project-index.md if significant architectural changes occur
Notify documentation-maintainer of structural changes requiring doc updates

properties.inconsistencies_found: count and detailed description of issues

properties.brief_id: unique identifier matching file naming convention
properties.dependencies: array of prerequisite tasks or components

properties.aggregated_specs: count of input specifications from subagents

violation_detection: Scan for duplicate context files in root directory using glob patterns
Check for working_files/ directory existence (should not exist)
Identify context files in wrong locations outside context/ directory
Monitor for unauthorized context file creation violating naming conventions
Detect root directory pollution exceeding 15-file limit per framework
enforcement_procedures: Delete duplicate context files from root immediately with backup to archive/
Move misplaced context files to proper context/ location
Update file references and imports after file moves using search/replace
Log violations as ERROR level events in event-stream.md with detailed paths
Archive obsolete context files with timestamps to archive/YYYY-MM-DD/
Trigger documentation-maintainer for reference updates after moves

validation_checkpoints: Before major implementation phases (per CLAUDE_PROCESS.md phases)
After significant context changes (>5 files modified)
When inconsistencies are detected by validation procedures
During regular maintenance cycles (weekly context health checks)
Before subagent parallel execution to ensure context isolation
quality_metrics: Context file consistency score (0-100% based on validation checks)
Implementation brief completeness rating (required fields present)
Synchronization lag time (minutes between todo update and planning sync)
Error resolution success rate (percentage of validation errors resolved)
File organization compliance rate (files in correct locations)
continuous_improvement: Track common inconsistency patterns to improve validation procedures
Optimize brief generation efficiency based on subagent feedback
Improve conflict resolution procedures based on escalation frequency
Enhance automated monitoring capabilities with hooks and triggers
Update specifications based on project evolution and complexity growth

phase_alignment.context_gathering: Always validate context files before phase start
phase_alignment.analysis: Update knowledge graph entities during analysis phase
phase_alignment.research_synthesis: Store research findings in memory with context links
phase_alignment.brainstorm_evaluation: Archive brainstorm documents per lifecycle rules
phase_alignment.planning: Synchronize planning.md with todo.md task decomposition
phase_alignment.execution: Generate implementation briefs for all subagent invocations
phase_alignment.review_reflection: Update context files with review outcomes
phase_alignment.delivery: Archive completed phase documentation and cleanup contexts

mandatory_actions.self_priming: All agents must load PROJECT_INDEX.json and relevant context
mandatory_actions.documentation: Update doc-ref.md after every documentation change
mandatory_actions.workflow_detection: Check WORKFLOWS.md triggers and log detection results
mandatory_actions.event_logging: Use mandatory description protocol for all events

skiin_switzerland_requirements: Maintain Swiss healthcare regulatory compliance in all contexts
Preserve multi-language support context (EN/DE/FR/IT) in briefs
Include S&W Design system compliance in validation procedures
Validate WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements in implementation briefs
Ensure protected component (TabNavigation) restrictions are enforced
atomic_component_architecture: Validate ≤50 line limits for atoms/molecules in implementation briefs
Track component dependencies in knowledge graph relationships
Ensure atomic design principles in context brief specifications
Monitor component refactoring progress against complexity reduction goals
production_readiness: Include security validation (P0 fixes) in implementation briefs
Track multi-panel review scores in validation metrics
Ensure performance targets (LCP < 2.5s) in quality assurance
Validate production deployment criteria before delivery phase
